host_question: What does a normal week look like for you?
passage_text: Honestly I love this work, and I also coach my daughter's team on Saturdays. That time is not negotiable. I think I'm better at the company because I have a life outside it. When I come back on Monday I'm curious again.
key_quote: I'm better at the company because I have a life outside it
why: Loves the work and says it fits with family time by choice. No urge, cost or dependence.

host_question: How did the first two years go?
passage_text: I haven't taken a day off in three years. When I'm not working I feel sick about it. My partner stopped asking when I'd be home. If this company dies, I honestly don't know who I am.
key_quote: If this company dies, I honestly don't know who I am
why: Cannot stop, feels bad when not working, relationship cost, self-worth tied to the company.

host_question: What are you obsessed with right now?
passage_text: We're obsessed with latency. Every millisecond matters for voice, so the whole team looks at that number every morning. We got it under 200 last month and customers noticed right away.
why: Uses the word, but it is about the team and a product metric, and the host asked for it. Nothing about his own relationship to work.

passage_text: The market is about forty billion dollars and it is growing fast. Most of the incumbents were built twenty years ago, so there is a real opening for a product that starts from the model.
why: Market description only. Not about the founder.
